use: Blockbench modeling reference; original orthographic character turnarounds

sheets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create a production-ready orthographic character turnaround sheet for an original Minecraft Java mod called 末影感染. This is a technical reference for building the SAME character in Blockbench with cuboid bones, not a poster.
Landscape 3:2 sheet, extremely crisp readable high resolution. Exactly THREE full-body views in three equally spaced columns: FRONT, RIGHT SIDE, BACK, labeled in clean Chinese 正面 / 右侧 / 背面. All three show precisely the SAME design, identical dimensions, proportions, armor plates and crystal placements seen from the correct angles. Front faces the viewer, true right side profile faces LEFT on the page (character's own right side visible), back faces away. True orthographic projection: NO perspective, NO three-quarter poses, NO action poses, NO foreshortening. Feet on the exact same baseline, heads on matching horizontal guide, shoulders/hips/knees aligned with subtle ruled guides spanning the sheet. Relaxed symmetrical A pose, straight limbs, arms slightly separated so hands do not obscure torso, both feet planted. Empty clear space between the views. The side view must show a coherent narrow side silhouette, not a second front view.
Minecraft / Blockbench aesthetic: built entirely from clearly readable cuboids, stepped bevels, box joints and flat planes; sparse pixel surface accents, no smooth organic sculpture, no chains of tiny decorative fragments. Readable geometry feasible in roughly 100-220 cuboids. Broad matte charcoal structural body, weathered muted ivory-gray chitin/bone armor plates, dark aubergine inner material, luminous amethyst-purple crystal accents. Purple light confined to crystals, clean neutral studio fill makes every dark form legible; no bloom haze. Light warm gray drafting-paper background, thin gray construction grid, restrained violet header. Clean silhouettes and edge lines, non-painterly polished 3D modeling reference. No environment, no weapons held in hands unless explicitly requested, no overlapping inset views, no unnecessary text, no logo/watermark. Add thin pixel-dimension rulers with the exact total height and maximum width below, body dimensions measured in Minecraft modeling pixels, where 16px=1 block. Labels must be clear and few. Preserve cuboid anatomy rather than anime/human anatomy.

Title exactly: 初期感染末影人
Character: the early infected form of an Enderman, recognizable extremely slender elongated black humanoid, small rectangular head, long straight arms reaching mid-shin, narrow waist, long slim shins. Overall standing height exactly 48px (3 blocks); maximum width across the forearms in this A pose 18px. Main body uses a 7px-wide, 8px-deep head, a narrow 7px torso and slim 2px limb bars. Feet simple short dark cuboids pointing forward. No mouth opening, two narrow inset violet eye slits, not a smiling skull.
Infection is at an early stage: almost all original black silhouette remains visible. A few thin asymmetric pale bone plates begin growing around the lower left ribs and outer RIGHT shoulder, with that right shoulder the only tall crystal on the upper body. A small vertical split in the center chest exposes a SINGLE short amethyst core. Two small crystal buds on the upper back, visible in side and rear, one tiny crystalline patch on LEFT forearm. No crystals on the legs, no crown, no bulky armor. Make the same asymmetric details physically consistent across all three views: front viewer-left = character right shoulder. The limbs are straight, ungimmicked, readable for simple animation.
At bottom add three tiny material swatches labeled 骨甲 / 暗质 / 紫晶. No additional drawings. Keep wide clean separation between all three silhouettes.

Title exactly: 畸变末影人
Character: evolved tall alien Enderman, height exactly 60px (3.75 blocks); maximum width across A-pose arms 28px. A strong distinct silhouette with a narrow body, extremely long articulated forearms and angular grasping hands. Torso a deep ribbed cage of 5 broad ivory-gray armor slats on each side over black tissue, enclosing one vertically floating faceted purple cuboid crystal; clearly show OPEN negative space around the suspended chest core. The torso is 12px wide and 10px deep, head 8px wide, lower legs dark slender 3px cuboids. Head has a vertically divided angular faceplate with a slim dark central cleft, a horizontal pair of recessed violet eyes, no conventional exposed skeleton skull. A short forked bone crest swept BACKWARD, NOT a spiky round crown.
Both shoulders carry layered hooked bone pauldrons, the character's RIGHT shoulder has a backwards-swept fan of exactly three amethyst crystal prongs while LEFT shoulder has only a shallow single crystal inset. Upper back carries a raised segmented spine of six broad dark plates ending at the waist, visible especially in right and back views. Hands have three long segmented claw fingers plus one thumb, represented as simple box segments. Lower forearms armored, feet have two blunt squared toes. Crystals are deliberate functional elements, not covering the entire body. Hip and knee joints visible and feasible to rotate. Avoid thick giant shoulders, armor skirt, elaborate hanging filigree or floating body chunks; only the chest core floats.
Bottom show small material swatches labeled 骨甲 / 暗质 / 紫晶. No additional diagrams. Maintain exact front/side/back shape correspondence including three right-shoulder crystal prongs and rear spine.

Title exactly: 晶壳锚卫
Character: an original stationary defensive creature guarding rift anchors. A squat broad quadrupedal living anchor, NOT a humanoid knight and NOT a stone golem. Total height exactly 44px (2.75 blocks), maximum width exactly 40px (2.5 blocks), overall depth exactly 36px. Four stout backward-jointed dark legs arranged around a low central body, chunky pale angular armor on the outside of each shin, broad flat two-toed feet. No arms, no hands, no handheld shield or sword. The front legs must not hide the chest in the front view.
The body is an armored inverted trapezoid cage, pale bone plates arranged as four large hinged petal-like shields around a central purple cuboid anchor crystal. In this NEUTRAL CLOSED state all shield plates remain folded, with a clear narrow cross-shaped glowing seam at the front; purple core partly visible through seam. The top has a low squared bone dome, flanked by two short horizontal forked crystal outriggers, not a tall crown. Under the front dome there is a small horizontal recessed slit eye in violet. Rear has a distinctive thick stepped anchoring tail, resting on ground, made of three linked dark cuboid segments ending in a broad ivory wedge; clearly visible in side and rear. A single purple connection socket on the upper BACK, and no eye on the back. Include geometric hinge blocks at the sides so the shields can unfold later, but ALL three views show exactly the same closed state. Communicate functional armor with sparse large pieces and wide planar surfaces; no rock texture noise.
At bottom add material swatches labeled 骨甲 / 暗质 / 紫晶. No inset of open state. Three views must be technically consistent, feet baseline and body height identical. Side view must show the creature's full 36px depth including its anchoring tail. The full-width 40px front and back silhouettes should be similar width and identical armor arrangement seen from opposite sides.
